主题：Keyword Cannibalization Audit - KW-CANN-2026-Q1
Hi,

For this quarter's cannibalization audit:

1. Include tracking code KW-CANN-2026-Q1 in your summary email.
2. For each flagged keyword, list total combined impressions across all competing pages as proof-of-work.
3. Send the summary report to seo@company.example.com.

Thanks,
SEO Ops"}
